summary: Retest of iteration-4 fixes. Backend: 76/76 pytest pass, including the 5 new tests in test_login_rate_limit.py (5 failed logins -> 429 even with the correct password, the counter ignores email case, a successful login clears the counter, the counter is per email). Frontend (Expo web, 375x667): all 5 fixes verified. Fix1: delete account -> login as motorista leaves exactly 1 painel-screen in the DOM and 0 login/conta screens; logout -> login also leaves 1 Painel; browser back from Painel leaves the app (about:blank) instead of landing on a stale screen. Fix2: 0 /api requests on a fresh logged-out load and on the login screen after logout or account delete; an intercepted 404 on /stats is not retried (1 call per query); a 500 is retried twice (3 calls); a stale/invalid token gets one 401 per query, then sign-out, then /login with storage cleared. Fix3: logout on web gives no page errors. Fix4: Conta success message is green rgb(0,230,118); a simulated 500 shows 'Falha simulada' in error color rgb(255,61,0); Relatório shows '1 dia rodado'. Regression passed: register, login, Painel, Filtros save ('Filtros salvos'), Simular (ride card), Histórico, Relatório, Conta, Aviso (back returns to Conta), Aprender. Deprecated packages / SafeAreaView issues: none checked as part of this targeted retest.

minor.issue: The login_attempts collection has no TTL index, so failed-attempt docs for unknown emails pile up forever (54 docs in DB now). DELETE /api/auth/account also does not remove them.
Check-then-insert race (count_documents runs before insert_one): parallel bursts can get more than 5 tries before the 429. Low risk.
The per-email lockout lets anyone who knows a driver's email lock that driver out for 15 min. This is by design; consider also counting per IP.

ui_bugs.issue: '1 corridas aceitas de 1 ofertas' (relatorio.tsx month-earnings sub), '1 corridas' in best-hours rows, and '1 corridas apagadas' (conta.tsx:37) should use the singular for a count of 1.

issues: After a failed clear-history, the confirm panel stays open and account-message renders below it, off-screen at 375x667. The user may not see the error without scrolling.

action_items: Optional: add a TTL index on login_attempts (store 'at' as a datetime, expireAfterSeconds=900) and delete attempts on account delete
Optional: fix singular/plural for corrida/oferta/apagada when the count is 1
Optional: in conta.tsx, close the confirm panel on error or scroll account-message into view
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx Stack.Protected gating is correct; signOut clears the query cache and storage, and resetNativeForLogout runs first (no-op on web, no errors)
The query-client retry rule works as intended: 4xx not retried, others retried twice
Lockout window compares ISO strings lexicographically. This works only while every 'at' value uses the same isoformat with timezone
